title: Tailoring a multilayer fine-grained solid electrolyte interphase by pulse electrochemical activation maneuver for stable Si/C anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7060-7070
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02060C, Paper
Changhaoyue Xu, Peng Jing, Pengfei Xia, Ye Jia, Jianan Peng, Qiujie He, Qingqing Liu, Zimo Song, Xuemei Zhang, Fanglin Wu, Xianyu Liu, Kaipeng Wu, Yun Zhang, Wenlong Cai
The fine-grained SEI layer was designed through the modulation of pulsed electrochemical activation to enhance the electrochemical performance of Si/C anodes.
